title: Yowie Group Limited Announces 2026 Annual General Meeting on 27 November in Sydney

content:
Yowie Group Limited (ASX:YOW) YOW (ASX:YOW) has announced its 2026 Annual General Meeting, set for Friday, 27 November 2026 at 2:00pm AEDT. The meeting will take place at the Azure Group offices, located on Level 20, 133-145 Castlereagh Street, Sydney NSW 2000.

Key Points

  • The 2026 AGM is scheduled for 27 November 2026 at 2:00pm AEDT in Sydney
  • Venue: Azure Group offices, Level 20, 133-145 Castlereagh Street, Sydney NSW 2000
  • Shareholders can attend in person or submit proxy forms as outlined in the AGM Notice
  • Physical meeting documents will no longer be mailed unless specifically requested by shareholders

Details of AGM Venue and Schedule

The Yowie Group Ltd Annual General Meeting will be held at Azure Group's offices at Level 20, 133-145 Castlereagh Street, Sydney NSW 2000, on Friday, 27 November 2026, starting at 2:00pm AEDT. The company issued the Notice of Meeting on 29 October 2026. This meeting is convened in line with corporate governance protocols, with Chairman Sulieman Ravell signing the shareholder notice on behalf of the Board.

Proxy Submission and Shareholder Participation

Shareholders are encouraged to attend the AGM in person. Those unable to attend physically should complete and return a Proxy Form following the instructions provided in the AGM Notice. Filing a Proxy Form does not prevent shareholders from attending and voting at the meeting in person. The Notice does not specify a proxy submission deadline beyond the instructions included.

Shareholder Communication Preferences and Electronic Delivery

Following legislative amendments to the Corporations Act 2001 effective from 1 April 2022, Yowie Group will cease sending physical meeting documents unless shareholders explicitly request mailed copies. The company urges shareholders to provide email addresses to receive communications electronically, including meeting documents, dividend statements, and annual reports. Shareholders can opt for physical or electronic communications via the share registry's online portal.
